entities.name: Sedgemoor
entities.description: A vast bayou surrounding the Witherbloom campus of Strixhaven University on Arcavios, home to strange swamp creatures and a source of magical components.

entities.name: Witherbloom College
entities.description: College of Strixhaven whose campus Sedgemoor encompasses.

entities.name: Central Islet
entities.description: Largest landmass in the swamp, home to two research sheds and an ancient tree stump.

entities.name: East Islet
entities.description: A spell component collection site inhabited by poisonous snakes.

entities.name: Marsh Banks
entities.description: Edge of the swamp with wooden docks.

entities.name: North Research Shed
entities.description: Gathering area for Witherbloom students and faculty.

entities.name: South Islet
entities.description: Islet with quicksand where students collect components.

entities.name: South Research Shed
entities.description: Storage for research supplies and harvesting kits.

entities.name: Underwater Spring
entities.description: Bubbling spring north of a small islet.
